description: This file contains a single PHP function 'smarty_function_sugar_replace_vars' that performs variable replacement within strings, used as a Smarty plugin for dynamic string processing in the SuiteCRM project.

methods.name: smarty_function_sugar_replace_vars
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in a string with corresponding field values, supporting optional curly braces and enum options, used as a Smarty plugin.
